claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the UConn Huskies men’s basketball team.
Dan Hurley led the UConn Huskies men’s basketball team to back-to-back NCAA Division I National Championships in 2023 and 2024.
The UConn Huskies women’s basketball team is led by head coach Geno Auriemma.
Geno Auriemma is a Hall of Fame head coach.
For the 2025-26 UConn Men's Basketball Staff, the Head Coach is Dan Hurley.
For the 2025-26 UConn Men's Basketball Staff, the Associate Head Coach is Kimani Young.
For the 2025-26 UConn Men's Basketball Staff, the Assistant Coaches are Luke Murray and Mike Nardi.
For the 2025-26 UConn Women's Basketball Staff, the Head Coach is Geno Auriemma.
For the 2025-26 UConn Women's Basketball Staff, the Associate Head Coach is Chris Dailey.
Dan Hurley previously coached at Rhode Island before joining UConn.
Dan Hurley previously coached at Wagner before joining UConn.
